name: Notre Dame Cathedral Paris (Color)
description: Located in the center of Paris, France, on the Ile de la Cité, it is the cathedral of the Catholic Archdiocese of Paris and a symbol of ancient Paris. The church is famous for its Gothic architectural style, sculptures and paintings on the altar, cloisters, doors and windows, and the large number of art treasures collected in the church. It shines with the wisdom of the French people and reflects people's yearning for a better life. The novel of the same name written by the writer Hugo with Notre Dame de Paris as the background is one of the top ten famous novels in the world and is famous all over the world.
